name: Pale Reach: Lady Serenya waits for each voiced line of 'Posthumous Confession' before the next (#13563)
contract: Accepting 'Posthumous Confession' 175123 from Lady Serenya Coldmere 164005 starts six voiced creature_text lines
(groups 3-8, SoundEntries 215212-215219, client files senerya1/2/5/6/7/8.wav in patch-O.MPQ, 8.40 / 13.44 /
8.24 / 12.72 / 1.12 / 4.84 s long) chained by SMSG_TEXT_OVER timers, and the last line credits the objective.
rev_20261009_63 gave lines 3-6 7000 ms each, so four clips were cut into by the next one (#13563).
rev_20261125_13563 sets those timers to the clip rounded up plus one second (10/15/10/14 s, line 7 keeps 5 s).
This case walks onto her world spawn 9960245, rewards the prerequisite 175122 and accepts 175123 through the
questgiver handler (the path that fires her SmartAI). Her line-of-sight greeting is a Say too and would replace
the chain's text timer, so the case lets it fire on arrival, as for a player walking up, before the accept; its
120-180 s cooldown covers the chain. For each of lines 3-6 it waits the clip length rounded
up after the line arrives and checks that the line is still her latest MONSTER_SAY (SMSG_MESSAGECHAT 150, row
12), so no clip is cut into, then that the next line follows. The old 7 s timers fail the first such check.
The last line and the credit follow. Audio playback itself is client-side and not observed.
